Committee: State Government
Sponsor: Whitt
Analyst: JT Mathis
Date: 01/20/2022
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 161 as introduced could increase the obligations of state agencies and institutions by a small undetermined amount dependent upon the difference in the cost of a United States flag or Alabama flag manufactured in the United States of America purchased by these state entities and the cost of flags manufactured outside of the United States of America otherwise purchased by these state entities.
Chris Pringle, Chair
State Government
